analogy.rationale: SLC6A9 (glycine transporter 1) is a neuronal transporter with negligible expression in these cell lines, so glycine transporter inhibitors should elicit little transcriptional response; other neurotransmitter transporter inhibitors share the same transporter-family mechanism and are similarly expected to be inactive in these cells.
